name: gizza-ai/video-silence-cut
summary: Remove silent gaps from a video (single-pass approximation).

tool.description: Remove silent gaps from a video to tighten pacing (jump-cut style). Provide either url or ref. threshold_db is the silence loudness cutoff in dB (default -30) and min_silence is the shortest gap in seconds to trim (default 0.5). Output is mp4. NOTE: single-pass approximation — audio is de-silenced but video may drift out of sync.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior video tool call. Use either url or ref.

min_silence.description: Minimum silent-gap length in seconds to trim (default 0.5).
